notes.title: Species: Unknown is coming October 23rd
notes.content:
[h2][b]🚀We’re thrilled to finally reveal that [i]Species: Unknown[/i] will launch into Early Access on [u]October 23rd[/u].[/b][/h2][h3]Even better, you don’t have to wait to try it out. [b]Our free demo is now live![/b]
[/h3][previewyoutube="7_vegkgZCns;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Dive in, explore the abandonned ship, and get a taste of the co-op survival horror experience we’ve been working so hard to bring you:[/p][p][/p][p]🧑‍🤝‍🧑[b]Play solo or grab your crew (up to 4 players)[/b][/p][p]🎮[b]Complete high risk missions[/b][/p][p]🔧[b]Upgrade your gear[/b][/p][p]👾[b]Hunt down terrifying creature or be hunted[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Drop your thoughts in the Steam forums or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/wdPzGuCF9Q"]Discord[/url] to discuss with the devs and other players![/p][p][/p][p]📅 [b]Wishlist and get ready for October 23rd[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747330/Species_Unknown/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]See you in the field, mercenaries.[/p]

notes.title: We want YOU in the Spotlight !
notes.content: [h3]📣[b]We want YOU in the Spotlight![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re putting together a [b]huge community highlight video[/b] for Species: Unknown — and it will be featured right here on our Steam page![/p][p][/p][p]🎥[b]How to take part:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play a solo or multiplayer session (as if you were streaming)[/p][/*][*][p]Record your gameplay and send it to us[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]👉Sign up via this form before [b]Sept 19[/b]: [url="https://forms.gle/8quk6c71EV8r6HYL6"]https://forms.gle/8quk6c71EV8r6HYL6[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’ll edit everyone’s footage together into one big epic highlight reel. [/p][p]This is your chance to:[/p][p]✨Get an exclusive access to the game before its release [/p][p]✨Show off your best plays [/p][p]✨Get featured in front of thousands of players [/p][p]✨Be part of something special with the SU community[/p][p][/p][p]👾[b]Note:[/b] If you’re playing in a group, only one person should sign up and send us the footage (so we don’t get duplicates)[/p][p][/p][p]Can't wait to see all your videos ![/p]

notes.title: Closed Beta Recap!
notes.content:
[h3]To all the testers, explorers, and survivors—[b]thank you[/b] for being part of the [b]Species: Unknown[/b] Closed Beta. Here's a very short recap![/h3][p][/p][p]Your bravery, feedback, and commitment helped us gather precious insights, fix bugs, and make the experience better for what’s coming next. We’ve already started working on the next steps… and yes, [b]Species: Unknown will be back[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/78a19f81c570618beead8ba18589ffa520f7413a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Here’s what your impact looks like in numbers:[/b][/h3][p]🚀 [b]8,208[/b] missions launched
💀 [b]1,908[/b] game overs
🕒 [b]281,200 minutes[/b] of total playtime
👁️ Most encountered creature: [b]ID_008[/b]
🏃‍♂️ Most purchased upgrade: [b]Stamina[/b]
[/p][h3][b]💬 Tell us:[/b][/h3][p]– Which creature gave you the chills?
– What upgrade saved your squad?
– How many missions did [i]you[/i] survive?[/p][p][/p][p]➡️ Want to [b]know what’s next before anyone else[/b]? Join our official [url="https://t.co/V5gR3RlFxc"]Discord[/url] to get exclusive behind-the-scenes updates, early info, and future testing opportunities.[/p]

notes.title: The Closed Beta is LIVE
notes.content:
[h2]🧪The Closed Beta for [i]Species: Unknown[/i] is currently underway — and it’s not too late to join the mission! Join our [url="https://discord.gg/wdPzGuCF9Q"]Discord[/url] and help us shape the future of the game.[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]🚀 How to Join[/b][/h3][p]✅ Head over to the Steam page and click the [b]"Request Access"[/b] button under the Playtest section.
This will put you in the waiting list to the beta build and allow you to start playing in the following days.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]💬 Join the Community[/b][/h3][p]For updates, bug reports, and to chat directly with the devs and other testers, join our [url="https://discord.gg/wdPzGuCF9Q" style="button" buttoncolor="#0d4d96"]official Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🗣️ We Need Your Feedback![/b][/h3][p]Once you’re in-game, you’ll find a [b]Feedback Form[/b] directly in the main menu (you'll also find it in the private Discord channel). Please take a few minutes after your session to tell us what you think — your insights are extremely valuable to the team![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]🎮 The Closed Beta runs until [b]July 8[/b] — Thanks for testing with us, and good luck out there… something’s watching. 👁️[/p]

notes.title: Official Gameplay Reveal
notes.content:
[h2]We’re thrilled to share the official Gameplay Reveal for [b][i]Species: Unknown[/i][/b]! Right in time for the Steam Scream Fest, get a closer look at the terrifying missions that await. Brace yourself for the dangers lurking aboard the abandoned ships — do you have what it takes to survive?[/h2]

[previewyoutube=-InDabCr_Yk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]In this gameplay reveal, you are introduced to a terrifying, immersive experience that combines intense FPS action with relentless horror. The abandoned spaceship's corridors are dark and filled with an atmosphere of dread, where every shadow could conceal a lurking threat. 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/ac27e3f7e959e152c0629f4fd90b66b22f1f1aa7.png[/img]

[h3]TEAM UP.[/h3]
No one survives alone but you can try... Collaborate with up to 3 teammates on different missions with varying difficulty levels, and objectives that can change depending on the map and the creature stalking you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/9ab7a6dde552fcfca967b46d20d9af071f542459.png[/img]

[h3]TRACK.[/h3]
Investigate your surroundings to gather vital clues and identify the alien threat. The corpses onboard aren’t just decoration — they might just give you a dead giveaway on what’s haunting you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/e07754e973f7a1e7af18e013e47d25f3e5480a03.png[/img]

[h3]SURVIVE.[/h3]
Survive at all costs by adopting the right group strategy. Use the environment to your advantage and make use of the tools at your disposal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/d668959d5aae89e296151bb23ffc35059827cb7d.png[/img]

[h3]REPEAT.[/h3]
Expand your list of kills and earn credits that you can use to customize your equipment, allowing you to face the fiercest creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/14a6a41f8281a0d6eb4103fe8f05c811faa89e0f.png[/img]


Join our [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS]Discord[/url] to learn more about the game.
Add Species: Unknown to your wishlist now and be among the first to embark on this spine-chilling journey:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747330/Species_Unknown/

notes.title: Species: Unknown is coming !
notes.content:
[h2]We're thrilled to announce our upcoming game, [i]Species: Unknown[/i]. The game is a gripping first-person shooter that dives you into a survival co-op experience like no other. The game will be available Spring 2025 on Steam.[/h2]

Sent on a mission aboard a devastated spaceship, you must identify and annihilate a terrifying threat through strategic collaboration with your teammates and the tools at your disposal.


[previewyoutube=jfEi1Q1AwPo;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45037108/5d45a60794e9bb291e5a3ea19cbbf7a61b9d14ac.png[/img]

[b]TEAM UP[/b]
Collaborate with your teammates on different missions with varying difficulty levels, and objectives that can change depending on the map and the creature.

[b]TRACK[/b]
Examine the evidence found on the ship to identify the creature you're facing and figure out how to eliminate it. Solve puzzles and find the weapon that will help you during the boss fight.

[b]SURVIVE[/b]
Survive at all costs. Use the environment to your advantage and make use of tools like the motion detector, shield, or mini-map to navigate the ship without getting killed. Adopt the right group strategy to eradicate or capture the creatures.
[b]
REPEAT[/b]
Expand your list of kills and earn credits that you can use to customize your equipment, allowing you to face the fiercest creatures.


Join our [url=https://discord.gg/kVq4sXS]Discord[/url] to learn more about the game.
Add [i]Species: Unknown [/i]to your wishlist now and be among the first to embark on this spine-chilling journey
